author: EmeraldSlay3r
body:
EmeraldSlay3r

I was banned for Hacking - Aimbot, Anti Knockback.

I think I should unbanned because I was not hacking. I think it was just lag. I have banned for about eleven months now. I have an few friends that want me to get back on the server. I didn't send an appeal right away because I forgot about server. I haven't appealed a ban before.

I hope you guys unban me because I love nebula in your server. Thank you
